subject: Ecuador
note: Hand-curated research for a Geographica episode about Ecuador. Claims are cited to a pinned Wikipedia revision (trusted_secondary). The equator is drawn as a route along latitude 0°, which is the line itself.

claims.text: The country’s name means literally "Equator" in Spanish, truncated from República del Ecuador, "Republic of the Equator".
Ecuador is the westernmost country that lies on the equator.
It has 2,010 km of land boundaries: with Colombia in the north (590 km) and with Peru in the east and south (1,420 km).
Quito, which remained the capital of the Ecuador department and the republic, is located on the equator.
Because of its location at the equator, Ecuador experiences little variation in daylight hours; sunrise and sunset occur each day at the two six o’clock hours.
